_note: Copy visual_execution onto the frozen automation/visual PATH; Host copies environment_fields to the run-level sandbox/environment/visual.json before freezing its environment_ref. visual_capture.backend hdc installs a HAP and starts its ability; adb installs an APK, reads ability as the launch activity and hashes the installed package against the accepted bytes; browser (a web target) installs nothing: visual_capture carries {backend: browser, url, device_id: the url host, viewport?}, visual_execution carries url with app_id = that host, the host deploys the accepted build and the served page declares its sha256 in <meta name=

>, which install and every capture re-read. Do not mutate the previously prepared Harmony config.json manifest. The visual configuration is hash-bound to the PATH and must not change during the assignment. visual_capture may carry avd and boot {argv, cwd?, timeout_seconds} for an emulator: when the device_id does not answer, the worker boots it (the SDK emulator for the avd, or boot.argv), waits for sys.boot_completed and leaves it running. Backend/tool/device selection and model use are explicit, no home-directory configuration or implicit model endpoint. Host supplies host_context_extension as authenticated runtime state, not an Agent-authored declaration. Install/capture inputs use the accepted PATH-specific HAP with readable module.json or pack.info app bundle/version identity. API secrets come only from the named process environment variable; do not store keys in this document. For viewport remove scroll_region/scroll_end_match. For scroll, source-reviewed target_match must identify the start; scroll_region must match exactly one actual scrollable node and scroll_end_match must identify the true endpoint within that region. Multiple or ambiguous regions require separate frozen PATHs or the full runtime adapter; repetition or missing scroll attributes never prove completeness.
